methodology.displayName: Co-Fund coalition outcome and participant marginal-effect methodology v2

estimandDefinitions.success_case_additional: Other participant or outside-funder resources unlocked on success, excluding the focal participant's own contribution. The indivisible total project deliverable is not assigned wholesale to one participant.
estimandDefinitions.expected_additional: The validated inclusion-versus-exclusion change in project delivery probability multiplied by the frozen coalition outcome or other resources unlocked, reported separately and withheld without identification.
estimandDefinitions.direct_causal_attribution: The focal participant's marginal inclusion effect under the validated interference-aware design. It defaults to non-additive and is not summed with cooperative allocation.
estimandDefinitions.verified_outcome: The total project deliverable or resources shown by reviewed settlement and delivery evidence to have occurred, without claiming participant-level additionality.
estimandDefinitions.cooperative_allocation: A non-additive Shapley allocation of the coalition-created outcome under the frozen contribution, exit, shortfall, and substitution rules.

methodology.baselineDefinition: Before publication, freeze the project, exact cost, deliverables, participant budgets and no-pool defaults, outside funding, split, withdrawal, shortfall, substitution, and automatic-obligation rules.

causalIdentificationPolicy.estimand: The participant-level causal estimand is the difference in project-delivery probability or other resources unlocked when the focal participant is included versus excluded, holding the eligible pre-inclusion state fixed.
admissibleDesigns: randomized invitation, waitlist, or contribution encouragement with cluster-aware analysis
pre-specified threshold or capacity discontinuity with interference-aware estimand
causalIdentificationPolicy.interferencePolicy: Treat the Co-Fund as a networked coalition. Model how inclusion changes other participants' contributions, exits, and automatic obligation increases; define the interference exposure mapping before estimation.
causalIdentificationPolicy.overlapAndPositivityPolicy: Estimate causal effects only in states with empirical support for both the with-participant and without-participant conditions. Fail closed when overlap or positivity is materially violated.
causalIdentificationPolicy.sensitivityAnalysisPolicy: Report pre-specified sensitivity analyses for unmeasured confounding, baseline misclassification, and interference. Withhold causal components when conclusions are not robust to the approved bounds.

evidenceSemanticsPolicy.publicCopyRule: Evidence may establish that an outcome occurred and its quantity. It must not be described as verified impact or verified additionality; causal additionality remains an assessed model output.

strategicBehaviorPolicy.baselineAntecedenceRule: A baseline can support additionality only when its material evidence predates the participant-facing offer or commitment and survives post-resolution consistency checks.
strategicBehaviorPolicy.strategicTimingRule: Use pre-specified invitation times and freeze the state before exposure; reject post-outcome inclusion or baseline selection.
strategicBehaviorPolicy.interferenceRule: Treat the Co-Fund as a networked coalition. Model how inclusion changes other participants' contributions, exits, and automatic obligation increases; define the interference exposure mapping before estimation.
strategicBehaviorPolicy.perverseIncentiveRule: Do not reward exaggerated budgets, artificial shortfalls, or harmful project baselines; audit automatic obligation increases.

methodology.algorithmDescription: Record the coalition outcome separately from participant-level effects. Predict funding and delivery from historical Co-Funds. Estimate a participant's inclusion effect only with an interference-aware design comparing supported with-inclusion and without-inclusion states. Compute Shapley only as a separate allocation view. Replace the observed coalition outcome with reviewed delivery evidence without converting occurrence into causal attribution.

referenceClassPolicy.uncertaintyExpansionRule: Reference classes support outcome prediction, not causal identification. Expand the 80% predictive interval at every approved broadening step and withhold when no defensible class remains.

uncertaintyPolicy.method: Use a pre-specified hierarchical predictive model and propagate parameter, outcome, baseline, interference, and measurement uncertainty by posterior or repeated-sampling simulation.
uncertaintyPolicy.confidencePolicy: The initial sample-size and calibration cutoffs are provisional governance floors. Low or moderate confidence may be shown only after a current health pass. High confidence is forbidden until temporal or otherwise independent holdout validation and uncertainty-aware calibration criteria are approved.

requiredBeforeHighConfidence: pre-registered temporal or otherwise independent holdout evaluation
uncertainty intervals for calibration intercept, slope, and interval coverage
documented robustness to approved confounding and interference sensitivity analyses

requiredCalibrationMetrics: out-of-sample probability calibration intercept and slope with uncertainty
out-of-sample Brier or proper scoring-rule result
blockedConditions: causal identification design is not validated
empirical calibration evidence is absent or ineligible
required state is missing or does not match the immutable state hash
input is outside the approved domain
unresolved evidence-integrity, duplication, or overlap failure
available modeled component would be published under blocked, warning, or stale health
warningConditions: reference class broadened beyond the narrowest approved class
material reliance on participant attestation rather than independent outcome evidence
calibration drift remains within a non-blocking warning band

sourceDataRequirements: immutable project specification, cost, and deliverables
participant keys and frozen contribution caps
each participant's no-pool default and outside-funding evidence
split, withdrawal, shortfall, substitution, and automatic-increase rules
audited resolved Co-Fund outcomes including failures
knownFailureModes: whole indivisible project is attributed to every participant
participant inclusion changes other participants' willingness or obligations
outside funder or substitute project would have delivered the outcome
strategic no-pool defaults inflate apparent additionality
Shapley allocation is added to direct marginal effects
outOfDomainConditions: no defensible no-pool default for a material participant
coalition value cannot be defined or audited
materialChangeTriggers: causal-identification design or sensitivity-analysis policy changes
evidence semantics or public outcome-label changes
provisional validation thresholds or high-confidence rule changes

aggregationPolicy.additiveClaimRequirement: A causal component may enter an additive caused-total only when every underlying resource or action has a stable unique claim reference and no claim reference appears in another additive component.
aggregationPolicy.overlapHandling: Outcome quantities may appear in explanatory views but verified outcomes are not caused totals. Direct marginal effects default to non-additive. Cooperative allocation is an alternative lens. Any additive causal aggregate requires unique claim references and must reject overlap.

shapleyPolicy.characteristicFunctionDefinition: For each participant subset, coalition value is the frozen project outcome or resources delivered by that subset relative to the subset's no-pool defaults, with outside funding and substitutes removed.
shapleyPolicy.approximationMethod: Above 12 participants, use deterministic seeded permutations, publish Monte Carlo error, and withhold when relative error exceeds the approved bound or the characteristic function fails monotonicity checks.

parameters.publicationRule: render deterministic terms and verified outcomes when valid; withhold every modeled causal component unless the exact active model has a current passing health snapshot
